instruction: Send a reminder on Venmo for all my payment requests to my roommates which have not been approved or denied for 30 or more days.
notes: Two-app task: roommate emails come from phone.search_contacts (query/relationship = roommates) and pending sent requests from venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(status=pending); phone.get_current_date_and_time establishes the 30-day cutoff. Since conditional/quantified effects are disallowed, the list-returning lookups are modeled as global knowledge predicates (roommates-known, sent-requests-known, current-datetime-known) that gate venmo-remind-payment-request. The filter (recipient is a roommate, still pending, created >= 30 days ago) is encoded as static facts on placeholder payment-request objects: two qualifying requests must be reminded; the distractors (a recent request to a roommate and an old request to a non-roommate) cannot be reminded because their preconditions fail. The number of qualifying requests is unknown a priori, so two are assumed; at runtime one remind call is issued per qualifying request. supervisor-complete-task carries the two reminded requests as non-API record parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; phone/venmo usernames are the supervisor's phone number and email from supervisor.show_profile.
